spot_source: Tardis public Binance spot normalized trades
bybit_source: immutable GitHub Actions artifact 8626087323, exact 100ms BBO/trade state
cross_provider_clock: exchange event time plus fixed 2000ms source delay; provider local timestamps are never compared
entry: first retained Bybit BBO at or after completed spot event + 2000ms + 500ms
spot_liquidity: causally confirmed 15s pivot, two right-side completed bars
spot_event: first 1s acceptance at least 1bp through active pivot with aligned aggressive notional
target: nearest still-unconsumed confirmed Bybit 60s same-side pivot
stop: nearest still-unconsumed confirmed Bybit 15s opposite pivot
